changes_from_1_9: S0 and S6 DNS arm (dnsExfil): a node dns call (NODE_DNS_CALL, unchanged) is not counted when its first argument is a plain string literal (single or double quotes, or a backtick), followed (after whitespace) by , or ) so nothing is joined to it, and its host is a reserved name (reservedDnsName; DNS_LABELS rejects a ${, an escape or a newline, so such a call is counted). The unit fires when NODE_DNS_CALL and DNS_DATA match (unchanged) AND (DNS_CUSTOM_SERVER matches the unit OR at least one dns call is counted).

reservedDnsName: lower-case, one trailing dot removed, must match DNS_LABELS; then localhost, or ends in .invalid / .example / .test / .localhost with at least one label before it (RFC 2606, RFC 6761). A bare TLD is not reserved.
DNS_CUSTOM_SERVER: a unit that calls setServers( or Resolver( excludes nothing: a query for any name reaches the server the code chose.

Not changed: NODE_DNS_CALL, DNS_DATA, the S6 beacon branch (network API sink + host identity, no execution sink), S1-S5, S7-S9, the facts, every gate, class, role, notice and excerpt text. A dns module bound to another name is still not read (as 1.9).

dns.dns_exfil:
export const dnsExfil = (s) => typeof s === 'string' && NODE_DNS_CALL.test(s) && DNS_DATA.test(s)
  && (DNS_CUSTOM_SERVER.test(s) || dnsCalls(s).some((c) => !reservedDnsName(c.host)));   // v6.25: was NODE_DNS_CALL && DNS_DATA (1.9)
dns.measured: the 9 v6.23 DNS-arm fires (dns-measure out.jsonl 09c38ff6; tarballs evicted 11-05, so scored on the dns call lines kept in recon capture reports): 8 still fire under 1.10 (all 5 MAL-labelled + 3 unlabelled probes, each a data-joined name), 1 drops (@jarvis_1234/env-harvest 1.0.4, the RF-9 case). 1.10 only narrows 1.9, so no other unit of the 3,404 can change.

dns_exfil.why: env-harvest 1.0.4 shape: reserved name in a plain literal
promises receiver, spaces around the argument
case and one trailing dot folded
data joined to a reserved suffix (the measured shape)
one reserved call beside one counted call

dns_exfil.unit: const { Resolver } = require('dns').promises; const r = new Resolver(); dns.lookup('a.test'); os.hostname();

dns_exfil.why: custom server and process data, but no dns call

unchanged: S1-S5, S7, S8, S9, the S6 beacon branch, the facts (1.8.1), every gate, class, role and notice; S0 and S6 change only through dnsExfil
